summary: OpenAI previewed a new API service tier, Ultrafast, that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster using Cerebras hardware, delivering up to 750 output tokens per second.

mechanisms.reason: Much faster token generation could enable higher aggregate inference throughput and more tokens served per task.
mechanisms.quote: it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second

categories.reason: OpenAI is using Cerebras custom silicon in production to power an ultrafast inference tier, signaling demand for non-GPU accelerator hardware.
categories.quote: Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

notable_reason: A frontier lab publicly adopting Cerebras hardware for a production inference tier is a notable signal of diversification in accelerator silicon beyond GPUs.
